reason: A long room name elides in the room header; the header row also carries the join and member controls.
A long sender name elides above its message (the audit's sample name is deliberately long).
A long file name elides in the middle, so the extension stays visible.
A supernode's name elides in its Settings row; it is user content of any length.
A placeholder hint may elide in a narrow field; the field's label says what it is for.
